title: peeters: FlowSOM on gated flow cytometry populations, differential abundance between conditions, and its figures
description: FlowSOM on a gated flow cytometry population over many FCS files (gated as ALN gating files say), per-file counts and medians, differential abundance between conditions per node or metacluster (as FlowSOM's GroupStats), and its figures: the FlowSOM tree with a band around every node that differs, and a node heatmap with each node as high as its share and a strip per comparison.
